prompt:
Create ONE finished premium Chinese product introduction poster for “金字塔表达工作室”, a structured-thinking and communication skill whose updated focus is learning through authentic practice. Highest available native resolution, portrait 2:3, target 2048 x 3072 if supported. Pure product introduction, absolutely no installation, usage instructions, commands, URLs, QR codes, platform names (no Codex, WorkBuddy, ChatGPT, Claude), or software logos.
Visual direction: refined Apple keynote product campaign, sophisticated minimalist editorial grid, luminous off-white and silver, crisp charcoal modern sans-serif Chinese typography (NOT traditional calligraphy or heavy serif), subtle ice blue and lavender glass refractions, ample negative space, thin separators and softly translucent feature cards. A beautiful optical-glass pyramid hero, with a few precisely aligned translucent layers suggesting accumulated understanding, clean studio environment. No landscapes, mountains, elaborate palace, busy decorative scenery. Clear hierarchy, big readable text, six balanced feature panels. Premium polished calm confidence.
Use exactly this copy, no other words:
Eyebrow “PYRAMID STUDIO”
Product name “金字塔表达工作室”
Main headline “把清晰表达，练成自己的能力。”
Subtitle “让每一次真实沟通，都成为理解与运用方法的机会。”
Principles line “结论先行 · 以上统下 · 归类分组 · 逻辑递进”
Section heading “完成这次表达，积累下次的能力。”
Six capability cards, all readable:
“清晰成稿” with “组织汇报、长文与故事线，让重点和理由清楚呈现。”
“方法可辨” with “指出实际用到的原理，连接对应章节与框架。”
“原理讲明” with “结合这次表达，解释为什么这样组织更清楚。”
“日常迁移” with “从工作汇报到生活对话，把方法带进真实沟通。”
“逻辑审阅” with “检查观点、分组与支撑关系，找到关键改进处。”
“渐进练习” with “通过简短复盘与按需练习，逐步形成独立表达能力。”
A concise elegant supporting statement “一份清楚的表达，一小段有用的复盘。”
Bottom closing line “从用得上，到想得清，再到自己会。”
Small footer “尊重事实边界，保留自然表达。”
All Chinese must be exact and sharp. This is a brand-level product introduction, no tutorial layout, no numbered steps or instructional command cards. Ensure the large headline fits elegantly on two lines and body copy is easily readable.
